The '''Tusker Glade''' was an area located in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Imperial Command Post]] utilized by [[Special Operations Group Four]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] was located in this area.
